$comment: The public Ambassador Program page (the front page, /; /join/ redirects there). The idea: think of someone who's figuring out what's next. The hero is the mockup's; the three covers are chapter titles and each chapter's opener flows from its cover. [N] marks a number still to be set. Every 'Become an ambassador' button goes to /apply/ (content/site/apply.json). The launch roster reads data/roster.json. The pin isn't on this page: it's the Contributing Member pin now, not an ambassador reward (see /contributing/). The page mentions the member community instead, in the path section.

you.$comment: Our why: one manifesto block under the hero, nothing else, in the ambassadors' own voice (we = the corps): why we spread the word about The Labs. Its one effect: it brightens letter by letter, line by line, as you scroll, and ends fully bright. Keep it to one statement and one effect.
statement: Work is changing faster than anyone can keep up alone.
The Upskilling Labs is a community where we learn and adapt together.
As ambassadors, we help folks who'd love it discover it—one conversation at a time.

labs.title: Worth being curious about.
labs.lede: It's free, run by volunteers, and it started in a public library a year ago.

habits.title: We decide together.
habits.body: Everyone gets a say in which problems we work on.

habits.title: We learn by building.
habits.body: We build real things for real problems, and make them to last.

habits.title: We pass it on.
habits.body: Whatever we learn, we share with the next person.

ripple.title: One conversation. Then a network.
ripple.lede: Each person you bring in often brings someone too.

rings.title: Someone you know
rings.body: One conversation, and their first workshop.

rings.title: Your neighbors
rings.body: A small team, which we call a pod, working on a real local problem.

rings.title: Everywhere
rings.body: Every neighborhood, everywhere. The future of work is coming either way. This way, more people get a hand in shaping it.

ripple.note: America's first lending library began with a dozen neighbors teaching each other. The Labs began inside a library.
ripple.videoLabel: The Labs orb as a planet, teal glowing from its upper left and red from its lower right, at the centre of dense rings made of networks that orbit it. A pulse leaves the orb, travels node to node through each ring, and leaps across the gaps between rings in small arcs of light, like synapses firing.

team.$comment: What you'll do: the three things, told as a story (first, then, one day), each with its own small brass soft enamel pin (public/join/moment-{icon}.webp): a cup, a mic and a handshake, in teal and red glitter enamel. The listening idea lives in the path section (Listening and leading).
team.title: Coffee. A mic. A welcome.
team.lede: Three moments, at your own pace. No pitch, no script.

roles.title: Start a conversation.
roles.body: Ask someone what they're curious about, and really listen. Over time, bring [N] people to their first workshop.

roles.title: Take the mic.
roles.body: Give one short talk to a group you're part of. We'll help you practice first.

roles.title: Welcome the next ambassador.
roles.body: Help someone new find their way in, the way someone once did for you.

title: You start by listening.
You end up leading.
path.lede: What you hear in every conversation helps shape what The Labs works on next. Your coordinator, a local volunteer lead, is with you the whole way.

steps.title: Raise your hand.
steps.body: Let us know you're interested. That's the whole first step.

steps.title: Join in.
steps.body: About ten minutes on your phone. Your coordinator gives you your Ambassador button.

steps.title: Listen first.
steps.body: Half an hour with the guide, then your first conversations. Ask, listen, and bring back what you hear.

steps.title: Then lead.
steps.body: Give your talk, and welcome the next ambassador. By then, you'll be ready.

button.title: The button
button.body: Given to you in person by your coordinator. It's how ambassadors recognize each other.
button.alt: The ambassador button: the orb mark on ink, ringed by THE UPSKILLING LABS and AMBASSADOR in white

members.$comment: The member community, beside the button. Being an ambassador is a way into the contributor community. Two doors that aren't exclusive: Supporting (light dues, a button) and Contributing (recognized for work, never bought). Neither is statutory membership, and neither buys a vote (design/research/recognition-system.md). No link or dues amount yet: how to join as a Supporting Member isn't set, and /contributing/ stays unlisted until the board approves the ranks.
members.title: The member community
members.body: Being an ambassador is a great first step into our contributor community, the people who build The Labs. There are two ways to become a member, and you can take both.

doors.name: Supporting Member
doors.body: Chip in light dues, and wear a button that says you back The Labs.

doors.name: Contributing Member
doors.body: Make something The Labs now runs on, like a better version of the guide you're about to use. It's recognized, never bought.

faq.title: Questions you might have.

items.a: No. Being an ambassador is free, and so is every program at The Labs. Supporting membership is the only thing with dues, and it's optional.

items.q: How much time does it take?
items.a: About ten minutes to join and half an hour to get ready. After that, it's mostly conversations you'd have anyway, plus one talk.

items.q: Do I have to sell anything?
items.a: Not at all. There's nothing for sale. Just share your story and point people to theupskillinglabs.org.

items.q: Do I need to be technical?
items.a: Not at all. Curiosity and a story of your own are plenty.
Yes, any time. You're always welcome back.
Your coordinator. You'll find their details in the guide.
